Package com.example.ecolums

Class CampusGoal

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.CampusGoal
public class CampusGoal extends Object
Represents a campus-wide sustainability milestone goal set by the Campus Sustainability Office (CSO).

Stored in the Firestore collection campusGoals. The AdminDashboard creates and archives goals; ProgressTracker reads them to compute current progress and fire milestone notifications.

Outstanding issues: "Top contributors" field for the archive view is not yet wired up.
